title: the harbor_master measure_only guard plants its own breach
intention: The harbor_master measure-only tooth is not blind because of a breach it plants itself, not because the live tree happens to hold one. A clean tree passes; a sieve that sees nothing still reds.
why: Measured 2026-11-12 on akienasus:  reds at test_no_breach_from_bus_client_lands_on_harbor_master with "0 breach(es) in all; these: ". The guard 'not mine and bool(breaches)' needs a breach elsewhere in the live tree, and the tree is clean. Ticket 7806309a8018 fixed the same guard in its sibling proof.
traces_to: RULE 1 (encapsulation; a clean tree is its aim) and Law 8 (a proof a hollow build could not pass: the blindness check stays, in a stronger form).
how: A new tooth runs the sieve over a scratch tree with one planted bus_client file importing cairn.devices.harbor_master and checks for exactly that row. The live tooth drops 'and bool(breaches)'. Built as 7806309a8018's planted tooth.
